Title: Mark employee present for today without date field
Description: Verify that attendance is marked as present for the current date when date is not provided
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 1 exists in DB
Test Steps: Provide employeeId = 1 and absent = false in JSON body without date field
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK with AttendanceModel JSON for employeeId 1 and date = today, absent = false; employee totalPresent incremented by 1 and lastAttendanceDate set to today

Title: Mark employee absent for a given date
Description: Verify that attendance is marked as absent for a specified date
Pre-Conditions: Employee with ID 2 exists in DB
Test Steps: Provide employeeId = 2, absent = true and a valid date in JSON body
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK with AttendanceModel JSON for employeeId 2, date = 2025-11-27 and absent = true; employee totalAbsent incremented by 1 and lastAttendanceDate updated to 2025-11-27

Title: Update existing attendance from absent to present
Description: Verify that when an existing absent record is updated to present, employee counters are adjusted correctly
Pre-Conditions: Attendance record exists for employeeId 3 and date 2025-11-26 with absent = true; employee totalAbsent and totalPresent reflect that record
Test Steps: Provide employeeId = 3, absent = false and date = 2025-11-26 in JSON body
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK with AttendanceModel showing absent = false; employee totalAbsent decremented by 1, totalPresent incremented by 1 and lastAttendanceDate = 2025-11-26

Title: Fail when employeeId is missing
Description: Verify that API returns 400 when employeeId is not provided in request body
Test Steps: Provide only absent = true in JSON body without employeeId
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Fail when absent flag is missing
Description: Verify that API returns 400 when absent field is not provided in request body
Test Steps: Provide employeeId = 4 in JSON body without absent field
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Handle non-existing employee gracefully
Description: Verify that attendance is saved even if employee record does not exist, and no employee counters are updated
Pre-Conditions: No EmployeeModel exists with ID 999 in DB
Test Steps: Provide employeeId = 999 and absent = false with a valid date
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK with AttendanceModel for employeeId 999; EmployeeRepo is not updated as employee does not exist

Title: Mark batch attendance with multiple valid employees
Description: Verify that batch API saves attendance for multiple employees and returns correct summary counts
Pre-Conditions: Employees with IDs 1 and 2 exist in DB
Test Steps: Provide a list with two valid entries: employeeId 1 absent = false, employeeId 2 absent = true
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK with savedCount = 2, presentCount = 1, absentCount = 1, invalidEntries = [] and savedRecords containing both attendance records

Title: Batch with mix of valid and invalid entries
Description: Verify that valid attendance records are saved and invalid entries are reported in invalidEntries list
Pre-Conditions: Employees with IDs 1 and 3 exist in DB
Test Steps: Provide a list with: valid entry for employeeId 1, entry with missing absent for employeeId 2, valid entry for employeeId 3
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK with savedCount = 2 for employeeIds 1 and 3, invalidEntries contains 2, presentCount and absentCount match the saved records, and savedRecords list only includes valid entries

Title: Batch call with empty payload
Description: Verify that API returns 400 when batch payload is empty
Test Steps: Provide an empty JSON array as body
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Batch call with null payload
Description: Verify that API returns 400 when payload is null or not provided
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch without body or with null JSON body
Expected Result: API returns 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'
